# CG-RES-017: Non-success response removed

A non-success response key is absent from the candidate.

**Why it matters:** Fewer documented error responses narrow the response space.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `response.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Response {status} of {operation} is no longer documented.
>
> The provider may still return it undocumented.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: 404 removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}, '404': {description: nf}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Response 404 of GET /x is no longer documented.

### Does not fire: success response removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}, '404': {description: nf}}
+       responses: {'404': {description: nf}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
